name: Cincinnati
living: the riverboat's twin smokestacks puff slow soft pixel smoke that drifts off to the side
the riverboat paddle wheel turns slowly and the boat's cabin lights twinkle
the Ferris wheel by the river turns slowly with its rim lights chasing
the Ohio River shimmers with rippling sunset reflections under the blue suspension bridge
the blue suspension bridge's cable lights twinkle on one by one
city tower windows flicker on as the sun sets behind the hills
orange and pink pixel clouds drift slowly across the sunset sky
light-tower lamp banks breathe softly, dust motes drifting through the cones
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
